policy: PULSE adopts MovieLens 1M (owner approval 2026-11-24, D-009) for calibration of the choice curve and the EXP-004 second test (research/protocol.md section 15). The raw and processed files are never committed (licence forbids redistribution); this manifest records URL, licence, size and SHA-256. The synthetic generator remains the controlled part of every experiment.

synthetic_generators.seeding: numpy.random.SeedSequence per master seed, spawned streams per component
